steps.text: Main board in the center
Draw {n} Trade cards faceup above the board; box the rest
First player: last winner (first game: random); others take Turn Order tokens clockwise
Non-player-color Action discs on board and Trade card spaces marked for your player count
5 random System cards in a row below the board: {x}
Galactic Fleet token at the top of the leftmost System
Random faceup Planet tokens and facedown Exploration tokens on the icons for your player count
Player-color Action discs and Cruisers plus all other tokens in a common supply; box unused colors
Each player: a Player board and Tip card
An Action disc on 0 of the Prestige track (first player's on top)
Credit and Strength counters on 0, Productivity on 3
Draw 7 Faction cards; discard up to 3 and redraw to 7
Deal 7 Faction cards each; keep 1, pass the rest left, until you hold 7
In player order, play a Faction card to start your Alliance and gain its Debut bonus
Set up as a 2-player game
Virtual Opponent color: 2 Cruisers and all its Action discs
Remaining Faction cards as a deck
You get no more Faction cards during the game
5 rounds; skip the War phase in round 1
Round 1: Production phase
